mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name, d.views, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.target_type = 'DESTINATION' AND b.target_id = d.id ) AS bookmark_count, MIN(dc.category_id) AS category_id FROM destinations d LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN destination_categories dc ON d.id = dc.destination_id -- 대한민국(7) 및 하위 지역 전체만! WHERE d.region_id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id FROM country_categories WHERE id = 7 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM country_categories WHERE parent_id = 7 UNION ALL SELECT c2.id FROM country_categories c1 JOIN country_categories c2 ON c2.parent_id = c1.id WHERE c1.parent_id = 7 OR c1.id = 7 UNION ALL SELECT c3.id FROM country_categories c1 JOIN country_categories c2 ON c2.parent_id = c1.id JOIN country_categories c3 ON c3.parent_id = c2.id WHERE c1.parent_id = 7 OR c1.id = 7 ) sub ) GROUP BY d.id, d.region_id, dt.name, cc.region_name, d.views ORDER BY (d.views + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.target_type = 'DESTINATION' AND b.target_id = d.id )) DESC LIMIT 50 ) t ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url, cc.region_name, d.views, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.target_type = 'DESTINATION' AND b.target_id = d.id ) AS bookmark_count, MIN(dc.category_id) AS category_id FROM destinations d LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN destination_categories dc ON d.id = dc.destination_id -- 대한민국(7) 및 하위 지역 전체 제외! WHERE d.region_id NOT IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id FROM country_categories WHERE id = 7 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM country_categories WHERE parent_id = 7 UNION ALL SELECT c2.id FROM country_categories c1 JOIN country_categories c2 ON c2.parent_id = c1.id WHERE c1.parent_id = 7 OR c1.id = 7 UNION ALL SELECT c3.id FROM country_categories c1 JOIN country_categories c2 ON c2.parent_id = c1.id JOIN country_categories c3 ON c3.parent_id = c2.id WHERE c1.parent_id = 7 OR c1.id = 7 ) sub ) GROUP BY d.id, d.region_id, dt.name, cc.region_name, d.views ORDER BY (d.views + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.target_type = 'DESTINATION' AND b.target_id = d.id )) DESC LIMIT 50 ) t ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
